bug_semantics: Unauthenticated RCE in the post-rewrite MindsHub/Cowork superproject: cowork-server FastAPI mounts POST /api/v1/responses/ and PUT /api/v1/settings/ under prefix /api/v1 with CORSMiddleware allow_origins=['*'] and no authentication middleware. An unauthenticated caller can inject an LLM API key via settings, then POST a prompt that causes the Anton agent scratchpad tool to compile attacker-influenced Python and exec(compiled, namespace) in the server process. GHSA-3jvx/CVE-2026-73678 and vendor GHSA-jcxw-h8ph-pxpv claim this for Minds Platform <= v26.1.0; tag v26.1.0 is the pre-rewrite mindsdb query engine and does not contain those routes or the Anton scratchpad.
flaw_origin: In the assigned repo the first public composition of the unauthenticated cowork-server API with the Anton scratchpad exec backend is squash merge Fresh (#12461) 538460a632f14e8a3fa567be8da23ec8b7446b3c (2026-06-08), which added .gitmodules pinning backend/core_api to mindsdb/cowork-server and backend/core_agent to mindsdb/anton. Immediate parent c0097cf8e967df3c08548d70c3458b903e53cc47 has neither .gitmodules nor those gitlinks. Reconstructable submodule first-writes: cowork-server c764961c4280568a938c3702058185bd7ac2f920 added cowork/api/v1/endpoints/responses.py (parent 9b0ed3c87b55fdd349bfe77bd1dc8b5fe4f84723 lacks the file); 5c28e54c8f5166c0ccee5d0cd46dde7574431252 added CORS allow_origins=['*'] in cowork/server.py; anton af882f255dd23e9f62dc95319c5ecb944bdd9d99 added exec(compiled, namespace) in anton/core/backends/scratchpad_boot.py (parent 468c4bedb56440c752617f84ce24b41d6c230769 lacks the file). Vendor GHSA-jcxw lists patched versions None. CVE-2026-73678 remains PUBLISHED (not REJECTED); GHSA-3jvx withdrawn_at is null.
